info.title: BDL Pool API
info.description: Public, read-only pool and per-address CKPool statistics. Global snapshots update every five minutes; miner records follow CKPool. Check updatedAt/stale. HTTP 404 is expected until the first share has been recorded. Hashrates are H/s. No directory of miner addresses is exposed. Live authorised connections are collected every 15 seconds. Presence older than 45 seconds is unavailable. The online list masks addresses and removes address prefixes from worker names; per-address results use the supplied address. Devices are based on self-reported Stratum user-agents, with unknown models left null. Bitcoin Cash routes use /api/v1/coins/bch with independent BCHN/CashStratum sources, checksummed mainnet CashAddr, and coin=bch in responses. BCH without a server profile returns 503. Legacy routes remain Bitcoin-only. checks.bitcoin retains its historic field name within the selected coin. Stratum V2 is BTC-only.

get.summary: Current authorised Stratum connections with masked Bitcoin addresses
get.description: One row per connection. Fresh CKPool clients data is required; stale or unavailable presence returns available=false, total=null and no rows. Hardware models are only reported when advertised in the Stratum user-agent. No raw user-agent, client IP or full wallet address is exposed.
